info.title: MICROSERVICE-DocTest-Delete Weather Alerts Unsubscribe-v4-spec
info.description: This API endpoint allows users to unsubscribe from weather alerts, enhancing their control over notification preferences. By utilizing this functionality, users can manage their subscriptions effectively and receive only the alerts that are pertinent to them. This resource is designed for consumers seeking to streamline their notification settings and reduce information overload. Typical use cases include individual users or organizations wishing to optimize their weather alert preferences.

delete.description:
This endpoint allows users to unsubscribe from alerts, ceasing any further notifications.

Make sure to provide any necessary identifiers to ensure the correct alert subscriptions are removed.

requestBody.description: This body should contain the necessary parameters for unsubscribing from alerts associated with the user. Ensure that the correct alert identifiers are provided to successfully process the unsubscription.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeRequest.description: The request body for unsubscribing from alerts. It is expected to be a string value providing details about the unsubscribe operation.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeResponse_2.title: Unsubscribe Operation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the unsubscribe operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number for the operation.

resultId.description: An identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the unsubscribe operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the unsubscribe operation in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the unsubscribe operation.

DeleteWeatherAlertsUnsubscribeResponse_2.description: Response object for the unsubscribe operation indicating the status and details of the operation.

createdBy.description: The user who created the unsubscribe operation.
